name: Eco Action
line: Over 70 butterfly parks and over 20 herb gardens across Delhi NCR.
deck: One public park in Vasant Kunj went from five per cent green cover to ninety, over a decade. That is the whole argument for this project, and we do not have a photograph of either state.

figures.label: Green cover in one Vasant Kunj park

scale.note: One park, drawn as the span its own source publishes. The bar is a decade of work and nothing else on this page is set at that scale.

aims.p: The test of a butterfly park is whether an insect nobody invited turns up. It is a slow test and it cannot be staged for a camera.

aims.h: Be wanted after the money stops
aims.p: A garden lasts because somebody needs what is in it. The aim is a plot a neighbourhood would defend, since the alternative ending is tarmac.

aims.h: Depth on one site, not a layer on fifty
aims.p: On airshed work the intent is a decade in a single park with the green cover measured at each end. It is the only version of this that anybody can check.

how.h: It is always somebody else's land
how.p: These are public parks and institutional grounds, not our sites. Which means every one of them needed a permission before it needed a plant.

activities.name: Butterfly parks
activities.p: You do not build one, you plant one: host plants for the caterpillars, nectar plants for the adults, and then you leave it alone long enough for something to find it. Over seventy of them, across Delhi NCR.

frame.alt: A butterfly feeding on a cluster of small flowers

activities.cap: A butterfly, in one of our own frames. Not a photograph of one of the parks — we hold none.

activities.name: Herb gardens
activities.p: The same trick, aimed at people. Over twenty of them, planted where somebody will actually pick from them. Usefulness is what keeps a garden alive after the funding ends.

frame.alt: A dense bed of leafy greens under cultivation

activities.cap: A cultivated bed at our farm, not one of these gardens.

activities.name: Airshed parks
activities.p: Ten years is the honest unit for this kind of work, and ten years is why almost nobody does it. Vasant Kunj is the park we have taken all the way, and the span it moved through is drawn at the top of this page.

frame.alt: A timber boardwalk running along a restored city waterway

activities.cap: A restored city waterway of ours. The Vasant Kunj park is photographed in neither state.

who.h: Whoever already walks through the park
who.p: These are public parks, so the people this is for are the ones who were going to be there anyway. Nobody is enrolled in a butterfly park.
Said plainly, because it is the design brief. A butterfly park is built to be found by something that was never invited.
Schools, offices and civic bodies with ground they are not using. What they get back needs less water and less mowing than lawn.

who.h: The people who will pick from it
who.p: Herb gardens are planted for use. If nobody harvests it, the garden has failed on its own terms rather than on ours.

done.h: Over seventy parks, over twenty gardens
done.p: Across Delhi NCR. PVR, American Express and Adobe behind the butterfly parks; Amazon and American Express behind the herb gardens.

done.h: One park, five per cent to ninety
done.p: The Vasant Kunj airshed park, over a decade of work, with The American Embassy behind it. It is one park. It is not a city figure and it is not an organisation figure, and we will not set it as either.

holes.what: The photograph above is a planting site of ours, not one of these gardens. Not one butterfly park, not one herb garden, and neither the before nor the after of the park that went from five per cent to ninety.
holes.unlocks: Three frames — one park, one garden, and Vasant Kunj then and now — would make this the strongest page in the section. The text is already there.

holes.what: The count here is over seventy. Elsewhere on our own site it has been seventy-eight. We have published the figure we can stand behind rather than the one that flatters us.
holes.unlocks: A current count with a date closes the gap between the two numbers we have been using.

holes.what: We do not name which park in Vasant Kunj, or say when its decade started.
holes.unlocks: A name and a start year. One makes the park visitable, the other makes the decade checkable.

statement.line: A park nobody needs gets paved.
statement.under: Which is why usefulness is the maintenance plan and not a nice extra.
